criteria.criterion: Normal CORE/DRAIN deadline deployment and measured cycle/HP/compute basis with margin
criteria.interpretation: Normative text requires a justified conservative bound with margin, not a precise counter for every internal state. A complete START-to-DONE_SAFE wall interval multiplied by the bound HWH clock and 25% margin may be reported as an estimated upper bound if the run and clock basis are bound; precise PL cycles remain NOT_MEASURED.
criteria.limitation: Neither the planned R09 nor physical R10 deadline profile had run at audit time; offline tests do not establish board timing.

criteria.criterion: ABORT while pending, late drain after deadline, and permanent isolation
criteria.limitation: R08 proves actual board pending ABORT and safe drain. T11 integrated RTL simulation proves DRAIN_TIMEOUT followed by legal late R drain and permanent ledger isolation. This does not claim a physical HP late-response trace; no approved board-side fault-injection control was identified.

criteria.criterion: Reset/recovery behavior at allowed lifecycle boundary
criteria.limitation: R08 verifies prior SAFE/empty ledger before cold reset deployment and proves pending-time ABORT/inner soft reset. The frozen interface forbids using FCLK reset/POR/cold reset to clear unresolved transactions; a system reset during pending is not a required or permissible test. A standalone reset waveform is not listed as a separate requirement.

criteria.criterion: DDR and buffer ownership tied to physical board, plus safe DDR test record
criteria.limitation: The probe reports two-phase 256-byte match at 0x10000000, but its original package remains API_OBSERVATIONS_SAVED_ACCEPTANCE_PENDING and independent review only closed server-release attachment. It does not prove the 32 MiB range or identify the installed DDR/PCB revision; the user-approved manual candidate remains the basis.
Offline PS infer/init compile/link succeeds; bundle does not rebuild BSP from sources, XSA, PL or bitstream and is not a hardware restore.

required_open_scope_from_existing_norms: Resolve observable GP0 BRESP for busy and invalid commands and finish remaining static rejection cases with unchanged state/epoch evidence.

Run the planned deadline profile and bind the complete START-to-DONE_SAFE interval, HWH clock basis, justified margin and configured nonzero deadline. A conservative total upper bound is acceptable; exact PL cycles remain NOT_MEASURED when unavailable.
No unresolved system reset may be cleared with FCLK reset/POR/cold reset; only permitted safe lifecycle reset behavior is in scope, and pending ABORT recovery is already demonstrated.

Late-drain and permanent-isolation logic is covered by integrated RTL simulation; no physical fault injection is required by the current record absent a controllable board-side injection path. Keep actual board pending-drain evidence distinct from the RTL scenarios.

Retain the 256-byte/two-phase cross-master DDR observation as limited evidence; preserve the user-authorized manual DDR candidate and unresolved physical PCB/installed-part identity, plus the limited PS-only rebuild scope.
